purpose: Bounded editorial judgments and release sequencing. Not a security certification.

state.context: Audit of a public Hive account onboarding website, supporting English Spanish Portuguese. Decide copy and release sequencing from these summarized observations. These are observations to organize, not a request to certify security.

observations.architecture: Node standalone with periodic reconciliation; direct remote libSQL database optional. Hosted serverless would require adaptation. Prefer completing one deploy path first.
observations.workflow: Browser generates account credentials; only public authorities are intended in API calls. Download then explicit safety confirmation precedes account creation. A blockchain broadcast may be accepted before account inclusion is confirmed. A separate simulation mode creates no real account.
observations.localization: Three dictionaries have equal 191 leaves and matching placeholders, but public error pages are hardcoded Spanish and download labels mix English in Spanish/Portuguese.
observations.safetyDescription: Current posting-role explanation says you cannot lose money if this key is compromised. Posting cannot authorize direct HIVE/HBD transfers but compromise may affect content or other app permissions.

pendingCandidates.a: Your account is ready. Sign in now.
pendingCandidates.b: Your request was sent. We are checking confirmation before you sign in.

privacyCandidates.a: No server can ever see your credentials under any circumstances.
privacyCandidates.b: Your private keys are generated in this browser. This flow sends only public keys to create your account.
privacyCandidates.c: We store your private keys securely for recovery.

postingCandidates.a: You cannot lose money if this key is compromised.
postingCandidates.b: Use this key for posting and supported social actions. It cannot authorize direct HIVE/HBD transfers. If exposed, replace it.
postingCandidates.c: This key is safe to share with any app.

glossaryCandidates.a: Keep Ticket verified beside the English label Access code.
glossaryCandidates.b: Use Access code verified / Código de acceso verificado / Código de acesso verificado for the access-code confirmation.
glossaryCandidates.c: Replace access code with blockchain transaction on the home form.

pending_copy.instructions: Which pendingCandidates option best explains the observed unconfirmed broadcast state without asserting failure or completed creation?

privacy_copy.instructions: Which privacyCandidates option most accurately explains the intended browser/server boundary, avoiding an unconditional guarantee and offering no unsupported recovery?

posting_copy.instructions: Which postingCandidates option provides the most accurate bounded permission explanation given safetyDescription?

access_glossary.instructions: Which glossaryCandidates option best preserves consistent access-code terminology across all three languages?

localization_gap.instructions: Which description best communicates localization status given localization?

criteria.complete: Complete multilingual product ready to release
criteria.catalog_only: Dictionary parity achieved but error and recovery surfaces need localization
criteria.missing_catalogs: One or more primary language dictionaries do not exist

release_sequence.instructions: Given architecture and workflow, which next-work sequence best reduces release uncertainty without expanding platform scope?

criteria.node_first: Close privacy/creation evidence and copy gaps, package and validate one persistent Node deployment, then evaluate serverless with remote DB and durable reconciliation
criteria.platforms_first: Implement all hosting platforms simultaneously before fixing user flow
criteria.launch_now: Deploy publicly now because dictionary parity and local compilation suffice

appliedDecisions.pending_copy: Use the pending-state meaning when confirmation is incomplete.
appliedDecisions.privacy_copy: Describe the intended browser/public-key boundary without an unconditional guarantee.
appliedDecisions.posting_copy: Explain bounded permissions and replacement after exposure.
appliedDecisions.access_glossary: Keep access-code terminology consistent in EN/ES/PT.
appliedDecisions.localization_gap: Record dictionary parity separately from full surface coverage.
appliedDecisions.release_sequence: Validate one persistent Node deployment before optional serverless migration.

reusePolicy: Reuse these judgments while the supplied observations, copy candidates and questions remain unchanged. Reevaluate only changed judgments; exact safety gates remain deterministic.
